steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Evaluation means making informed judgements about how effectively a dance communicates its intention | Key Fact: Effective evaluation requires clear criteria — such as how well movement, structure and design serve the intention | Key Fact: Evaluation builds on description and analysis — you must first understand what happens and how it works | Key Fact: A judgement must always be supported with specific evidence from the dance

steps.title: Homework & Consolidation
steps.body: Consolidation, retrieval on key terms from evaluating dance works, and one past-paper question.
